question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2
solution: The correct answer is **"exhausted."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Exhausted"** means to be completely tired out or depleted. (बहुत थका हुआ; चकनाचूर) • **Example**: *After running a marathon, I was completely **exhausted**__.* • The sentence implies that something has been used up or depleted, making "exhausted" the appropriate choice. • The word is an adjective, describing a state of being. • The correct answer is Option 2. • Correct passage: Buck __pranced__ over against the sled, __**exhausted**__, sobbing for breath, helpless. This was Spitz’s opportunity. He sprang upon Buck, and twice his teeth sank into his ______ (3) ______ foe and ripped and tore the flesh to the bone. Then Francois’ lash ______ (4) ______, and Buck had the satisfaction of watching Spitz receive the worst whipping as yet ______ (5) ______ to any of the team. ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "exterminated"**, means to completely destroy or eliminate something, usually referring to pests or vermin. (बड़ी संख्‍या में लोगों अथवा पशुओं को मार देना; संहार करना) • **Option 3, "excited"**, means to be enthusiastic or aroused by something. (किसी की भावनाओं (प्रसन्‍नता या अधीरता) को उभारना, किसी का भावोत्तेजन करना) • **Option 4, "eloquent"**, means to speak fluently and persuasively. (सार्वजनिक प्रसंग में वाणी का प्रयोग करने में दक्ष; वाक्‌चतुर) 3f:Tfc8, The correct answer is **'undetermined.'**
